picks.title: Canva launches Code 2.0, offering AI website building to every user — including free accounts
picks.excerpt: Canva launched Canva Code 2.0, a major upgrade to its AI-powered coding tool that turns plain-language prompts into interactive websites, apps and experiences — now available to every user, including free accounts.
picks.rationale: Major prompt-to-website release now free for every Canva user — instantly changes what designers can ship without code tomorrow.

picks.title: Design tokens are prompts now
picks.excerpt: The primary consumer of a design system has changed species: tokens are no longer written for human engineers but parsed by AI models, reframing design tokens as prompts for machine-driven UI generation.
picks.rationale: Reframes design tokens as machine prompts — an actionable shift in how designers should author systems for AI consumers.

picks.title: The store that rearranges itself — Generative UI, Part 2
picks.excerpt: An experiment takes generative UI from blueprint to a working e-commerce funnel — five personas, a live model in the loop, 200 simulated shoppers — and argues page-level generative UI is closer to production than it looks.
picks.rationale: A concrete, tested generative-UI funnel showing page-level personalization is near production — a fresh look at where UI design is heading.

picks.title: Q&A: Ali Tamijani, CEO of Novineer
picks.excerpt: DEVELOP3D talks with Novineer CEO Ali Tamijani about the startup's AI-driven reverse engineering and generative design tools for additive manufacturing and product design.
picks.rationale: AI-driven reverse engineering and generative design for additive manufacturing — a credible signal for product/CAD designers' workflows.
